s: Dine kanpot hattallit, ubo k"g seipim: tallit sheen lah arba kenapot — petura min hatztzitzit, shenneemar: "al arba kanpot kesuteka". Yesh lah yoter mearba kenapot — chayyebet, shenneemar: "asher tekasseh bah", vehay qera yetera hu, ella lerabbot baalat chamesh kenapot o yoter shechayyebet, uma raita lerabbot baalat chamesh ulemaet baalat shalosh? Merabbeh ani baalat chamesh sheyyesh biklal chamesh — arba, umotzi ani baalat shalosh sheen biklal shalosh — arba:

Vehoil velo nitrabbu baalat chamesh kenapot o yoter ella mechamat sheyyesh bahem arba kenapot, mikkan atta lamed shebbaalat chamesh kenapot o yoter — en tzarik lehatil tzitzit lekol kanpot hattallit, ella learba [mehem] bilbad. Veim abar vehetil lechamesh kenapot — abar al "bal tosip":
Keshehu metil lebaalat chamesh o yoter — yatil bearba kenapot hamruchaqot zo mizzo yoter, mishshum shenneemar: "al arba kanpot", vehamruchaqot zo mizzo [hen yoter] nikkarim shehen kenapot:

Tallit shehaya lah arba kenapot vechatak qeren echad baalakson veasahu shette kenapot — hare naaset baalat chamesh kenapot venishara bechiyyubah. Vehu haddin im chatak shette qeranot baalakson — hare naaset baalat shesh kenapot:

Ap-al-pi shehalaka shebbaalat chamishsha kenapot o yoter chayyebet, mikkol maqom tob lizzaher lekattechilla shello laasot beshum beged yoter mearbaa kenapot, mippene sheyyesh choleqin upoterin oto min hatztzitzit:

Mi shehigbiah kanpot tallito vetapar hakkepalim ad shennira keillu hakkenapot mequtztzaot beiggul velo nishar shem kanap, ap-al-pi-ken lo niptera mitztzitzit, dekol kamma shello chatakam legamre min hattallit mikkelal daadayin hu tzarik lahem, vesopam lachazor litchillatam, vaadayin hem nechshabim mikkelal hattallit, vahare yesh lah arba kenapot. Vechayyab lehatil tzitzit al meqom kanap harishon ap-al-pi shehu akshav tapur labbeged, kevan shessopo lachazor litchillato. Veim lo kapal hakkenapot beiggul, raq kepalam beinyan shennishar adayin shem qeren al meqom hakkepel — metil hatztzitzit al meqom hakkepel, kevan sheyyesh bah toar kanap:
Malbushim shel or — peturim min hatztzitzit, shenneemar: "al kanpe bigdehem", veen niqra beged ella shenneerag:

Haya rob hattallit min haor umiutah min habbeged, ap al pi shekkenapeha hem gam ken mehabbeged — petura. Abal im rubbah min habbeged umiutah min haor, ap-al-pi shekkenapeha hem gam ken min haor — chayyebet, lepi shehakkol holek achar iqqar habbeged, shenneemar: "asher tekasseh bah", mashma shechiyyub tzitzit taluy beoto cheleq mehabbeged hamkasseh et iqqar haggup:
Im hattallit shel or ubeged tapur tachteha — petura. Abal im hi shel beged veor tapur tachteha — chayyebet, lepi shehattachton tapel leiqqar habbeged:

Haya bah shelosha kenapot veasa bah shalosh tzitzit, veachar-kak asa lah od kanap rebii veasa gam bo tzitzit — hare hashshalosh tzitzit harishonim pesulim, vetzarik lehattiram velachazor ulehatil battallit, lepi shemmittechilla keshehetil hashshalosh tzitzit babbeged — hayeta asiyyatan bipsul, sheadayin lo hayeta hattallit mechuyyebet betzitzit kelal, shehare lo haya bah adayin arba kenapot, veap-al-pi sheachar-kak asa bah gam hakkanap harebii, mikkol maqom en hashshalosh tzitzit harishonim chozerim lihyot kesherim al yede kak, kevan shello asa bahem atzman shum maaseh chadash lehakshiran, vehattora omra: "gedilim taaseh" — velo min heasuy kebar bipsul:

Veken haddin im apillu lo asa bah ella tzitzit achat, o apillu im lo karak ella chulya achat, veachar-kak hishlimah learba kenapot veasa bahen tzitzit — tzarik lehattir hachulyot o hatztzitzit shennaasa bipsul velachazor velahatilam battallit:

Abal kol hatztzitzit shennaasu battallit achar shekkebar hayeta bat arba kenapot — hare hem kesherim, ap-al-pi shehayu teluyin battallit beshaa shehayeta hattallit pesula mechamat hatztzitzit shennaasu bipsul, mikkol maqom lo nipselu al yede kak hatztzitzit, kevan shehen atzman naasu bekashrut:

Tallit shehayeta arukka kishtayim vekopelah lishtayim umitattep bah — yesh omerim shemmetilin lah tzitzit keshehi kepula, dehaynu shette tzitzit bimqom hakkepel — echad mikkan veechad mikkan, mishshum dezeh hammaqom niqra "kanap" bishat haatipa, shehattallit hi kepula, ushette tzitzit beqarnot haechad min rashe hattallit hatteluyin. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik lehatil hatztzitzit bemaqom hanniqra kanap keshehattallit hi peshuta, shehare setama asuya lehitpashshet ukemupshetet dami kevan shello teparah, laken lo yatil hashshette tzitzit bimqom hakkepel, mishshum dikshettitpashshet hattallit yihyu hatztzitzit beemtza hattallit, ella yatil bearba qarnoteha happeshutim. Umeachar shello nitbarer lanu halaka kedibre mi, laken yizzaher kol adam shello lehitlabbesh kelal betallit kepula, ella im ken teparah achar shekkepalah. Vaapillu lo teparah ella meruach achat, mikkol maqom kevan sheenah yekola lehitpashshet od mikkepilatah, laken ledibre hakkol metilin lah shette tzitzit bimqom hakkepel, shehu hammaqom hanniqra kanap keshehattallit kepula:

Tallit shehetil lah shette tzitzit bekanap echad — hare zo pesula, shehare abar al "bal tosip". Veim chatak tzitzit achat mehem, apillu chatak et harishona veheniach et hashsheniyya — hare hi keshera. Veap-al-pi sheasiyyat hashsheniyya hayeta bipsul, shehare baasiyyatah abar al "bal tosip", ukeshechatak harishona lo asa shum maaseh behashsheniyya, shehare hayeta kebar asuya, vehattora omra: "gedilim taaseh" velo min heasuy kebar bipsul — apillu hake hashsheniyya keshera, mishshum demah shehetil hashsheniyya beod sheharishona teluya battallit, kevan sheyyesh issur de"bal tosip" baasiyya zo, laken en asiyya zo nechshebet kelum, ukeillu lo asa kelal dami, veachar-kak keshechotek et harishona umakshir et hattallit behashsheniyya — chashib yoter lemaaseh, venechshab lo az chatikat harishona keillu oseh hashsheniyya, veen kan "taaseh — velo min heasuy kebar", shehare lo hayeta asuya adayin, kevan sheasiyyatah hayeta beissur — en zo nechshebet asiyya kelal, veakshav hu sheoseh otah bemah shechotek harishona:

Veken haddin im hetil chamesh tzitzit betallit sheyyesh bah chamesh kenapot, veachar-kak chatak echad mehen, ben shechatak echad mehaarba tzitzit shehetil battechilla ben shechatak et tzitzit hachamishit shehetil baacharona — hare hattallit keshera min hattaam shennitbaer:

Malbushim shehem setumim lemala upetuchim lematta veyesh lahem arba kenapot, kegon ellu hammalbushin sheppotechim otam lematta mishshene tzedadehen, im rubbam patuach — chayyabim betzitzit. Veim rubbam satum — hare zeh keillu haya kullah satum, veen zeh niqra kanap, ulekak hem peturim min hatztzitzit. Veim chetzyah patuach vechetzyah satum — metilin oto lechumra vechayyabim betzitzit. Abal en mebarekin alayv, desapeq berakot lehaqel. Veen yotzein bo beshabbat, deshemma patur min hatztzitzit vahare hem kemashoy. Vaapillu lekarmelit sheen bo ella issur derabbanan — en yotzein bo, velo ameru sepeq dibrehem lehaqel — ella keshekkebar naasa hassapeq issur, abal asur laasot sepeq issur derabbanan lekattechilla:

Malbushim shehem petuchim lematta mishshene tzedadehem, kegon tallitot qetannim shellanu, im rubbam patuach vehu rotzeh lepotran mitztzitzit al yede sheyyiqba bo retzua hamchabberet shene kanpe hammalbushim mechetzyo ulematta, kede sheyyihyeh rubbo satum veyippater min hatztzitzit — tzarik sheyyizzaher sheyyiqba et haretzua lematta min hachagor davqa, kede sheyyehe rob hassatum rob hannireh laenayim, deim lo ken yihyeh asur mippene marit ayin. Vedavqa kesheqqobea retzua hamchabberet, abal im qobea haqqerasim hamchabberim shene kanpe hammalbush, apillu im qobea otan lematta min hachagor — en moil kelum lippater min hatztzitzit, kevan shehu yakol liptoach et haqqerasim beqal — en zeh chashub chibbur kelal, im lo shehaqqerasim nikpapot meod beinyan shei epshar lepotchan ella al yede maaseh, azay hen chashubin chibbur umoilin liptor min hatztzitzit, im hem qebuin mehachagor ulematta:

Velaken tzarik lizzaher betallitot qetannim shellanu shemmetilin bahem tzitzit, sheyyihyeh rubbo patuach mishshene tzedadayv rob hannireh laenayim. Vegam yizzaher shello liqboa bo qerasim lematta min hachagor. Vaapillu im hu lemala min chetzyo, kegon shehattallit-qatan arok meod, mikkol maqom asur mippene marit haayin. Vaapillu im en haqqerasim nikpapim meod beopen sheepshar lepotcham benaqel — apillu hake asur mippene marit haayin:
Kanpot hattallit shemmetilin bahem tzitzit — tzarik lihyot merubbaim davqa velo agullim, sheen iggul niqra kanap:

Mitznepet ap al pi sheyyesh lah arba kenapot — petura, shenneemar: "kesuteka asher tekasseh bah" — perat lemitznepet sheenah asuya lekassot et haggup ella et harosh bilbad. Vaapillu mitznepet shebbeartzot hammaarab sheshshene rashe hammitznepet mushlakim al ketepam vegupam, ap al pi shemmitkasseh bah rosh[o] verubb[o] — petura, kevan sheiqqarah lekassot harosh asuya:

Sudar shennotenin al tzavvar bemalkut eretz yisrael, shenniqra belashon arabi "shid" — patur min hatztzitzit. Ap-al-pi sheyyesh bo shiur tallit sheyyitbaer leqamman siman taz, veap-al-pi shenneheneh bo bachamma mippene hachamma ubaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim, mikkol maqom kevan sheiqqar hannachatam enah lahanaat kissuy ella lehishtammesh bahem, litzror bahem maot uleqanneach hazzea — lo miqre kesut kelal:

Malbushim shel gelilot ashkenaz useparad, shehem petuchim millipnehem lemala umillematta, veyesh lahem arba kenapot, shettayim milmala ushettayim millematta — peturim min hatztzitzit, mippene sheiqqar mitzvat tzitzit hu sheyyihyeh shette tzitzit lepanayv ushette tzitzit leacharayv, kemo shennitbaer besiman ch, abal beellu hammalbushim shekkol haarba kenapot hem millepanayv vei epshar lelobsham beinyan acher — yesh lomar shello chiyyeba otan hattora kelal. Velaken nahagu lehaqel. Abal kol yere shamayim yachamir leatzmo laasot qeren achat agulla, kede shello yihyeh lo arba kenapot merubbaim:

Malbushim sheqqorin "raq", shemmechubbar lemala chatikat beged merubbaat umunnachat al ketepo meachorayv, sheqqorin "qalanar" — peturin min hatztzitzit, shehare letzad mala en lo kenapot, raq kanpot ha"qalnar" [ha]munnachim meachorayv, veen zeh kenapot, hoil veen shette haqqeranot shemmeachorayv mekuvvanot keneged hakkenapot shemmillepanayv, velaken en niqraim kenapot kelal, mippene sheenan qetzeh habbeged, vahare zeh domeh lehattoper shette kenapot beemtza habbeged, shebbevadday eno tzarik lehatil sham tzitzit, mippene sheen zeh kanap haamur battora:
